_about: Which legislative districts include part of Boston. A district counts if its name contains one of `include_if_name_contains` and isn't listed in `exclude`. Districts were redrawn after the 2020 census, so each map lists the General Courts it applies to. Edit this file if a district is wrong; run `python3 tracker.py --check-delegation` to see the members it selects and where the House members live.

maps.name: 2011 redistricting
maps.notes: 16th Suffolk (Revere, Chelsea, Saugus) and 19th Suffolk (Revere, Winthrop) don't include Boston.

maps.name: 2021 redistricting
maps.notes: 11th Suffolk became a Chelsea district in 2021. 16th and 19th Suffolk cover Revere, Chelsea, Saugus and Winthrop.
